# ADR-003: Memory is git-backed Markdown (gajae-way axes)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2026-11-05

## Decision
Long-term memory is a separate git repo of human-readable Markdown organized on the gajae-way axes. Every change is a commit, so it is diffable, revertible, and auditable.

## Alternatives rejected
Vector DB as primary store (opaque, hard to correct by hand); SQLite-only (not human-editable).
